name: CHEG 3124
title: Heat and Mass Transfer
description: Conductive heat transfer; heat transfer coefficients and design of heat exchange systems. Radiation heat transfer, evaporation; design of mass transfer processes including distillation and extraction; analysis and design of diffusional processes such as gas absorption and humidification. Analytical and numerical methods for the solution of simple partial differential equations describing transport phenomena.
requirement_description: CHEG 3123 and MATH 2410Q. Corequisite: CHEG 3128, 3151; open only to School of Engineering students.
